observations: body: the line numbers 5 to 40 stand in the right margin and the locators «p. 211.» (L7) and «p. 212.» (L31) in the left margin; in «p. 211.» and «p. 212.» the 2 is printed broken, like £. The only note is set in one line across the page.

body L23, L24: the denominators of the fractions 1/3 and 2/3 are printed blotted, like 8; read as 3 (compared with the 3 of 2/3 in L44 and of p. 135, and the two parts together make the whole thickness).
body L5: the o of «areolas» is printed broken, open at the top.
body L12-L13: a blot hangs from the foot of the p of «aperi» (L12) down to the 0 of «90°» (L13); it is not a sign.
body L17: the m of «transeuntem» is printed with a stroke hanging from its last stem, like q.
body L24, L28: a short upright stroke stands over the u of «Itaque» (L24); a speck stands between «intra» and «eam» (L28), at the foot of the line. They are not signs.
body L41: a short stroke like an apostrophe stands before «Alteram»; it is not a sign.
body L30: a speck stands over the e of «reliquasque»; it is not an accent.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
